objective: Close root findings S1, S2, and the functional half of S5 by giving every selected command one physically meaningful decision-work/cache snapshot, typed budget projection, independent metrics-on/off oracle, and compatible JSON/text contract.

risk.rationale: Counter ownership, cache transitions, terminal snapshots, typed failures, command projection, and conformance cross store, CLI, and runtime boundaries; a wrong shared contract amplifies every later review.

disallowed_actions: Create a dev-swarm manifest or launch while any exact input remains UNBOUND
Use more than one implementation writer in this conflict domain
Use two projections of one command result as metrics orthogonality evidence
Use helper-call counts, constant labels, source shape, or test-only skips as physical proof
Write the canonical complexity table or final capability re-advertisement under this candidate
Run unrestricted broad gates repeatedly on rejected intermediates

non_goals: Launch before accepted stable input bindings exist
Refactor large Python or Rust hot files
Replace typed budget failures with generic diagnostics
Review devcontainer, CI, host, packaging, or agent wrappers

invariants.statement: Work begins only from exact accepted compositions and successors, a clean stable base, frozen selected commands, and final counter owners.
invariants.falsification_test: Leave one input UNBOUND, use a REQUEST_CHANGES candidate, alter one reviewed byte, or omit a selected consumer; status must remain blocked.

invariants.statement: Every cache and decision-work counter has one owner, unit, formula, transition, aggregation, overflow rule, and terminal snapshot.
invariants.falsification_test: Alias entry to reads/misses, omit invalidation, double-count revalidation, overflow a boundary, or project stale state; focused oracles must fail.

invariants.statement: Equivalent frozen authority is exercised by independent metrics-disabled and metrics-enabled production commands; removing only metrics preserves result, output, exit, effects, response, cleanup, and first error.
invariants.falsification_test: Synthesize both sides from one result or change live behavior only when metrics are enabled; the oracle must fail.

invariants.statement: Every selected command projects stable terminal counters and typed budget failure through declared JSON/text contracts while excluded commands remain explicit non-claims.
invariants.falsification_test: Remove one selected projection, alter its unit/envelope, or claim one excluded command; tests and conformance must fail.

invariants.statement: One Claude writer produces an immutable candidate reviewed by an independent Fugu session; accepted product delta alone enters the shadow composition.
invariants.falsification_test: Move candidate bytes during review, let the writer review itself, or import a branch tip; acceptance and integration must fail.

validation.command: Recompute every accepted composition/successor parent, head, tree, patch/report digest, changed paths, and clean state.
validation.purpose: Prevent work against moving or rejected inputs.

validation.command: Return READY or BLOCK with production call graphs, selected commands, owner/formula tables, orthogonality oracle, and deliberate regressions.
Run focused counter/cache/projection/CLI tests, exact boundaries, 1x/3x/10x, deliberate regressions, cross-runtime conformance, format, strict Clippy, and source-doc checks.
validation.purpose: Verify the immutable candidate without broad-gate amplification.

validation.command: Freeze parent/head/tree/patch/write-set/log digests and clean state; a fresh independent Fugu session reviews only that subject.
Port only an accepted product delta, run focused gates per delta, then run the unrestricted broad gate once on the stable composition head.
validation.purpose: Reduce repeated validation and integration delay.
